title: Bell-Guided Body Scan
description: A calm drone with bowl chimes marking each step of a body scan. Follow the on-screen prompts.

guide.text: Settle into a comfortable position and gently close your eyes.
Bring your attention to your breath. Let it move naturally.
Notice your feet and legs. Let them feel heavy and relaxed.
Move your attention to your hips, belly and lower back.
Notice your chest and shoulders rise and fall with each breath.
Relax your arms and hands, all the way to your fingertips.
Soften your jaw, your forehead and the muscles around your eyes.
Now sense your whole body at once – calm and supported.
When you are ready, slowly open your eyes and return.
